description: Validate a GitFlic API token against /user/me, then store it in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Linux libsecret) or chmod-0600 file. Refuses to store an invalid token. Use --as <name> to store under a named account; --stdin to read the token from stdin.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

token.description: API token (else read from stdin if stdin=true)

name: gitflic_auth_login
